```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(SmartEDA)

democracy_data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-11-05/democracy_data.csv')

```
```{r}
# data analyzing; 
    ExpData(data=democracy_data,type=1)
# data structure    
    ExpData(data=democracy_data,type=2)
# numerical variables
    ExpNumStat(data = democracy_data)
# category variables
    ExpCTable(data = democracy_data, Target = "is_democracy", margin = 1, clim = 10)


```
